d:
Saibar thana pulis ne karmatand, jamtara aur narayanpur thana kshetr ke vibhinn saibar addon par chhapamari abhiyan chalakar char saibar apradhiyon ko range hathon giraphtar kiya. apradhiyon ke pas se kul 13 pharji mobail phon baramad kie gae, jinke madhyam se ve saibar thagi karte the.
